question: The Elephanta Caves are located in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Elephanta Caves **are located in **Maharashtra state, India.**
 
• The caves are situated on the Elephanta Island which is a** UNESCO World Heritage Site**.
 
• The caves are known for their **rock-cut architecture** and **sculptures** depicting Hindu mythology.
 
• The main cave houses a huge **Shiva sculpture** known as the** Maheshamurti.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gujarat **is a **neighboring state** of Maharashtra, but the Elephanta Caves are not located there.
 
• **Rajasthan** is a state in **northern India **and is not in the same region as Maharashtra where the Elephanta Caves are located.
 
• **Karnataka **is a state in **southern India** and is not in the same region as Maharashtra where the Elephanta Caves are located.
